lines.text: This password leaked. Your app knows, but never sent it.

lines.tts: Apps like One Password do this. How?

lines.text: First, the password becomes a forty-character hash.
Only the first five characters leave your phone.
The breach list returns every hash that starts the same, and your phone compares.
Our test got two thousand look-alikes, and password123 appeared over two million times.

lines.text: Building sign-up? Check this way, and the password never leaves the phone.
